page.overview:
What is Shurikens?

The [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shuriken Shurikens] (Japanese: 手裏剣; literally: "hidden hand blade"), also known in the West as "throwing stars" or "ninja stars", are traditional Japanese concealed weapons that were generally used for throwing, and sometimes stabbing or slashing. They are sharpened hand-held blades made from a variety of everyday items such as needles, nails and knives, as well as coins, washers and other flat plates of metal.

Shurikens can come in a variety of forms. Some are manufactured while others can be improvised from tools. The edges of shuriken are often sharpened so they could be used to penetrate skin or open arteries with the littlest of ease.

The ninja stars are now the traditional projectile weapons for members of the diabolical ancient cult known as the Brotherhood of Shadows including Noob Saibot, the deceased older brother of Sub-Zero, whose soul was corrupted because of the ordeal with the Brotherhood of Shadows' sacred treasure which belongs to their eternal master, the fallen Elder God Shinnok. Noob Saibot uses them in Mortal Kombat: Deception.

Reiko also uses these in Mortal Kombat 4 and Mortal Kombat Gold. In Mortal Kombat: Armageddon he throws several Shuriken one-by-one, his nearest (to the opponent) hand throws and the farthest hand holds the shuriken. In Mortal Kombat 1, he uses one during the game's story mode to wound Reptile.
